svg.title: Lab-tested melanotan II didn't match its labels
svg.desc: Lab-tested melanotan II didn't match its labels. TGA lab test, 2026, 5 seized nasal sprays, same label: 73% to 180% of the labelled amount. Danish-led lab study, 2015, vials from 3 online shops: 43% to 88% of the labelled amount.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: TGA: 22 to 54 mg estimated vs 30 mg labelled per bottle. 2015 study: 4.32 to 8.84 mg vs 10 mg claimed; 4.1% to 5.9% unknown impurities.

svg.text: Percentages are Jabbit arithmetic. Sources: TGA safety advisory, Aug 17, 2026; Breindahl et al., Drug Test Anal 2015.
